items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: I wrote it for Shockey, but they didn't even tell me thank you.

ctx.x: But you know when I ask any musicians to hum for me the voice of Stardust, they don't know it. I like it. It's pretty good. You know. Yeah. I wrote it for Shockey, but they didn't even tell me thank you. I guess he couldn't play another one.
Yeah. It's interesting. Well, I had a special arrangement on it.
